description: Needs sign-in (connect this server with OAuth, or pass an API key as the Authorization: Bearer header). Makes a remix of a game on YouGame for the creator: a copy of that game's latest build, under the terms its creator set (shown on https://yougame.co/g/<slug>/remix), published at once as a new game of the creator's own. Needs the creator's API key or sign-in, and a game whose creator allows remixes. The remix starts as a minor variant, available from the original game rather than discovery; a remix of a private game starts private, seen only by its creator until they make it public on its Manage page (the original's testers are not added). For substantially different gameplay, upload the changed build, then choose Major remix on its Manage page with a distinct title and thumbnail. The reply has the new game's slug and a download link for its build (GET it with the same Authorization header): download the zip, make the changes, and ship them with update_game on the new slug. Keep every YouGame.coins.charge call the build has, or the update is refused.

slug.description: The game to remix: the last part of its URL, https://yougame.co/g/<slug>.

title.description: The remix's title, 1–80 characters. Default: the original's title followed by “remix”.

name: remix_game
